title: Tailwind Design System
summary: Sets up Tailwind theme tokens, component classes and typed variants so a UI stays consistent without piles of repeated utility strings.
description: Tailwind projects drift: five shades of gray, three button paddings, and a 40-class string copied into ten files. This skill pulls those decisions into theme tokens and a few real components, so a color or spacing change happens in one place.
It audits what exists before it adds anything, and it keeps Tailwind in charge instead of wrapping it in custom CSS.
useWhen: A project has inconsistent colors, radii or spacing
The same long class string appears in many files
You are adding dark mode or a second brand theme
A new component needs variants such as size and intent
body:
# Tailwind design system

Make the design decisions explicit, then make the code follow them.

## Steps

1. Audit first. Search the markup for arbitrary values (`bg-[#1a2b3c]`, `w-[13px]`) and list the most used raw colors, font sizes and radii. Show the counts before changing anything.
2. Define tokens in the theme, not in components. Tailwind v4: `@theme { --color-brand-500: ...; --radius-card: ...; }` in the main CSS file. v3: `theme.extend` in the config. Name tokens by role (`surface`, `text-muted`, `brand`), not by value (`blue-dark`).
3. Support dark mode through semantic variables that switch under `.dark` or `prefers-color-scheme`, so components never write `dark:` pairs for ordinary colors.
4. Extract a component only when a pattern appears three or more times. Prefer a framework component (React, Vue, Svelte) over `@apply`.
5. Build variants with a typed helper such as `cva` (class-variance-authority) and merge overrides with `tailwind-merge`. Variants are named by intent: `intent: primary | quiet | danger`, `size: sm | md`.
6. Replace the raw values you found in step 1 with tokens, one file group at a time.

## Rules

- No new arbitrary values without a comment saying why a token does not fit.
- Never build class names by string concatenation: Tailwind cannot see a class that only exists at runtime. Map each option to a full class string.
- Keep focus rings and contrast intact: body text at least 4.5:1.

## Report

Tokens added, components extracted, raw values removed (before and after counts).

example.prompt: Our buttons are all slightly different. Fix the design system.
example.result: Found 14 button class strings with 6 padding combos. Added tokens `--color-brand-500` and `--radius-control`, one `Button` component with `cva` variants (`intent`, `size`), and replaced 41 call sites. Arbitrary values dropped from 58 to 9; each remaining one has a comment.

faq.question: Does it work with Tailwind v3 and v4?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks which version is installed and writes tokens in the matching format.

faq.question: Why avoid apply?
faq.answer: It hides utilities in a second stylesheet and loses the benefit of reading styles next to the markup. A component in your framework does the same job with better tooling.

access: Reads markup and CSS across the project
Edits the Tailwind config, theme CSS and components
